doc.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27

title: Drinks, and Laine running three bands of unruly kids
summary: After a pause for refreshments, Laine says he had three bands on the street at once, and the boys misbehaved whenever his back was turned.
